Monica, saw Lavu just launched Marty AI, the first restaurant platform connecting POS, payroll, and scheduling data into a daily briefing.

A launch like that usually opens more in-market multi-unit operators than the team can cover before momentum fades, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Lavu off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Lavu needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Monica, last bit of proof for Lavu.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Lavu's reply rate likely compares to other vertical SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
